text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, students and trainers were gathered in the field at Chairwoman Akikawa's order...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
A bountiful harvest! A massive amount of giant pumpkins
grew in the fields this year. And so—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Discipline!! Through the harvest,
exert yourself in further strengthening your body!!
choice_data_list: Let's do our best together, Jordan!
Let's do our best together, Jordan!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ugh. That hot-blooded stuff is so suffocating! Just wing it, I say.

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Jordan, let's do it together while chatting it up~.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
It's so haaaard!!
This stalk is way too thick to cut?!

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
And like, the size is totally insane!
How're we even supposed to carry it?
choice_data_list: Looks like this won't be so straightforward.
Looks like this won't be so easy, huh?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Impossible for an Umamusume? Huh?
Then who the hell could possibly win it?

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey Jordan! Look at that...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (KABOOOOM!!)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Ohoho... How delightful.
This really does seem like it'll be fine training.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Hmph! Hmph! Hmph!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whaaaat~~!?
Tearing it apart with your bare hands is allowed!?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: The King commands it. Harvest every last bit.

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainers
text_block_list.text:
Yes, as you command!
Split into stalk team and transport team, begin!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Thinking there's no need to get your own hands dirty, is that it?
...Or could it be you just lack confidence?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rip rip rip... Thud!)

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Providing work to my subjects is the king's duty.
Did you think there was any other reason?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Ohoho.
I am glad to see you having fun.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Winning that easily... that's practically cheating.

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Well, can you blame 'em?
Like, aptitude? Talent? She's just built different from us."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Potential...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: "Cut from a different cloth," or whatever. What? You still believe in that?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ......Don't screw with me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While desperately searching for Tosen Jordan after she ran off—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Screw you!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Fugununuh... pwhaaah!
Dammit! I couldn't catch it~~~!!!
choice_data_list: Jordan, you've been harvesting all this time?!
Jordan, you've been harvesting this whole time!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Don't you dare help me.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I'll show 'em it's a breeze.
Aptitude, natural talent, none of that crap matters!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Look here, pal...! I've had to put up with
all of Golshi's nonsensical training sessions, too!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Even with things people say you can't do with these nails! I can do every single one of 'em!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: DON'T YOU SCREW WITH MEEEEEE--!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (KABLAM!!)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah!!!!
This is what I'm truly made of!!

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Haha... Ahahaha! No way!!
You seriously caught it!? That's insanely awesome!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before anyone knew it, the pumpkins Tosen Jordan
harvested had piled up like a mountain—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*... That's the last of it!
How's that? Top marks for both size and portion, right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Heheh... Right?!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: It's so noisy... Hm?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Take this, and thaaat!!"é

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Well... you seem to have some backbone at least.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I can still keep going...!
This isn't all I've got!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to the hard work of Tosen Jordan and the others,
the pumpkin harvest was finished before sunset!
